meta.title: Bound for Oz
meta.description: Instant browser preview of the Bound for Oz theme with all pages created.
meta.author: Bound for Oz

steps.code:
<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
foreach ( get_posts( array( 'post_type' => array( 'post', 'page' ), 'numberposts' => -1, 'post_status' => 'any' ) ) as $p ) { wp_delete_post( $p->ID, true ); }
$pages = array( 'home' => 'Home', 'pack' => 'The Pack', 'about' => 'About', 'book' => 'Book a free call', 'checkout' => 'Checkout', 'free' => 'Get the Pack free' );
$home = 0;
foreach ( $pages as $slug => $title ) {
  $id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_name' => $slug, 'post_title' => $title, 'post_content' => '<!-- wp:pattern {"slug":"aus/' . $slug . '"} /-->', 'meta_input' => array( '_wp_page_template' => 'page-no-title' ) ) );
  if ( 'home' === $slug ) { $home = $id; }
}
update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', $home );
update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' );
flush_rewrite_rules();
